events.title: Iran says it destroyed US military radar in Bahrain in retaliatory strike
events.summary: First direct attack on US military installations for months was in response to US airstrike on communications tower Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it has targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to a US airstrike on a communications tower in Sirik overlooking the strait of Hormuz. It is Iran’s first direct attack on US military installations for months.

events.title: Iran reports shooting down US Predator drone off its southern coast
events.summary: Iran reports shooting down US Predator drone off its southern coast Iran’s navy said on Friday that it shot down a US MQ-1 Predator drone over the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian media. The semi-official IRNA news agency reported that the drone was downed near the Sirik coast in the Kuhestak region.
